# Build farm for SUPERCUT

Lane farm1, 14 Nov 2026. Other PCs build, test, package and run SUPERCUT for lanes on c4. Git, agents and the
source of truth stay on c4. A farm PC holds a plain copy of a project folder (a "mirror"), never a git repo.
Nothing is ever pushed with git.

## Which PCs are ready

| PC | Root | Ready | Build | Tests | Package | Scripted run | Lanes at once |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[pc-b]` | `C:\UE` | **yes** (17:33) | yes | yes | Development and Shipping | yes, offscreen | 2 (builds queue, see below) |
| `pc2` | `C:\UE` | **yes** (18:02) | yes | yes | Development | yes, offscreen, slow: add `-TimeoutSeconds 900` | 1 (16 GB RAM, Studio windows open) |
| `[pc-c]` | `F:\UE` | **yes** (17:58) | yes | yes | Development | yes, offscreen | 2 (builds queue, see below) |
| `pc4` | `C:\UE` | **compile only** (18:09) | yes (editor and game targets) | **no** | **no** | **no** | 1 (12 GB RAM, runs hot) |

pc4: Smart App Control (Windows code integrity policy `VerifiedAndReputableDesktop`, enforced) blocks every DLL we
compile. The editor could not load `UnrealEditor-Supercut.dll` (`GetLastError=4551`, Code Integrity event 3077), so
tests, cooking and the game cannot run there. Builds do run: use pc4 only to check that a change compiles
(`build pc4 <name> <logs> -Jobs 4`, and `-Target Supercut -Jobs 4` for the game target). Nothing on its policy was
changed and nothing should be; turning Smart App Control off is the owner's call.

The root table also sits at the top of `farm/farm.sh` (`root_of`). On every PC: engine in `<root>\UE_5.9`, mirrors in

scripts in `<root>\Farm\_farm`.

# Lane shell1 (round 2) handoff: the soundstage hall

14 Nov 2026. Worktree `D:\UE\wt\shell1`, branch `shell1`, from `5767556`. Three commits:

- `81a8f53` SUPERCUT shell1: soundstage hall round every room, Hall tuning, tests
- `c849bb9` SUPERCUT shell1: hall materials saved for instancing, four work lights, hall is studio tone in a freeze
- `ba8ab10` SUPERCUT shell1: lower-flats test room and its picture script [taste: owner review]

Not merged, not rebased, not pushed. Log of the day: [LOG.md](<[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/shell1/LOG.md>).
Pictures: [shots](<[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/shell1/shots>).

The owner asked: "the skybox is just plain black, make it look like a film set warehouse, with scaffolding and such."
Every room now stands in a soundstage: a concrete floor with a tape line, padded walls with steel columns and a stage
door, a catwalk at 8 m, scaffold towers, stacked road cases, a lighting truss over the set with hanging lamps (some
lit), a steel roof, four dim work lights and thin haze. The set itself is lit as before; the hall is dim.

## How the layout is made

All of it is code: [SupercutHall.cpp](<D:/UE/wt/shell1/Source/Supercut/SupercutHall.cpp>). No line in any room file.

1. When a room is built, `ASupercutRoom` calls `ASupercutHall::BuildFor(*this)` (one line, before the "ROOM built" log).
   `TearDown` calls `ASupercutHall::TearDownFor(*this)` (one line).
2. The hall reads the room: the box round its solid parts, the floor under the start, its loose parts that do not
   collide (the desk lamp, desk things), and the dark studio slabs round it (`BuildLight` makes those).
3. The kept-out box is the room box plus `HallMargin` (400 cm). No piece but a floor tile may touch it. A piece that
   would is left out, and the log line counts it ("pieces left out").
4. The hall floor is the underside of the floor block the player starts on. That is -50 in most rooms. In
   `c_the_cutaway` it is -1050, because its start block reaches down to -1050. Floor tiles run under the set wherever
   no part of the room reaches lower; over a pit there is no tile, so the pit drops out of sight below the hall floor.
   The test rooms `hall/ledge` (start on the wind machine, 4.8 m up) and `hall/perch` (start on a 14 m post) show the
   floor from above.
5. Everything sits on the kit's 400 cm grid. The rig runs on the edges of the grid box round the kept-out box. Walls
   stand 3 cells out from the rig

bool USupercutRun::Pick(int32 OfferIndex)
{
	checkf(Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Picking, TEXT("USupercutRun::Pick: no upgrade screen is open"));
	if (!Offer.IsValidIndex(OfferIndex))
	{
		return false;

	const FName Key = Offer[OfferIndex];
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("PICK taken: card %d, %s"), OfferIndex + 1, *Key.ToString());
	Offer.Reset();
	USupercutAudio::Get(this).PlayFlat(TEXT("ui_pick"));
	Grant(Key);
	SetPaused(false);
	EnterRoom(RoomIndex + 1, false);
	return true;
}

{

{
	checkf(Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Playing || Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Picking, TEXT("USupercutRun::PracticeEnterRoom: not in a room or on the upgrade screen"));
	check(Time);
	Time->OnFroze.AddUObject(this, &USupercutRun::OnFroze);
}

{

}

## 1. The authoring route

Chosen: an editor commandlet runs a Python script, and the script drives the engine's own Niagara toolset.

```
UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe <copy>\Supercut.uproject -run=pythonscript -Script=<copy>\Tools\make_vfx.py
    -EnablePlugins=NiagaraToolsets -AllowCommandletRendering -unattended -nopause -nosplash -abslog=<log file>
```

Inside, every edit is one call: `unreal.ToolsetRegistry.execute_tool("NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System", tool, json)`.
The toolset is the experimental plugin `Engine\Plugins\Experimental\Toolsets\NiagaraToolsets` of 5.9. It is switched
on by the command line only, so the game and the `.uproject` do not depend on it.

Why this one: it needs no person and no open editor, it takes about two minutes, and the whole recipe is one text
file in git. Each run deletes and rebuilds every asset, so the assets always match the script.

What the script starts from, all engine content, nothing downloaded:

- `/Niagara/DefaultAssets/DefaultSystem` as the template system. Its own Fountain emitter is removed.
- `/Niagara/DefaultAssets/Templates/Emitters/DirectionalBurst` as the template for every emitter.
- `/Niagara/DynamicInputs/UniformRange/V2/RandomRangeFloat` for random numbers per particle.
- `/Niagara/Modules/Update/Size/ScaleSpriteSize` for growth over life.

The textures and the materials are ours: the script imports the PNGs and builds six unlit materials node by node.

  deleted. Size rules are applied on every run.
- Frame-rate pairs on [pc-b]: the second run of a pair is 10 to 16 fps slower whatever it is, so alternate the order.
  At 1080p the game is CPU-bound there; use 4K to see a GPU cost.
- A `Tuning.txt` beside the package exe is read by every run of that package: remove it after.

#!/bin/bash
# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59
#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship
#   farm.sh run     <host> <name> <log folder> [run_demo.ps1 args]   {P} = the mirror folder there, e.g. -Script {P}\Script\main8.txt
#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
set -u
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)

root_of() {   # one line per farm PC: ssh alias, root folder there (engine in <root>\UE_5.9, mirrors in <root>\Farm)
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    pc2)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    [pc-c])   echo 'F:\UE' ;;
    pc4)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    *) echo "FARM unknown host '$1' ([pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4)" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
}
fwd() { echo "${1//\\//}"; }   # C:\UE -> C:/UE for scp and tar

# copy remote path $2 (forward slashes) from host $1 into local folder $3, masking user and computer names in text files
pull() {
  local host=$1 src=$2 dst=$3 un cn
  mkdir -p "$dst"
  scp -r -q "$host:$src" "$dst/" || return 1
  un=$(ssh "$host" 'echo %USERNAME%' | tr -d '\r\n'); cn=$(ssh "$host" 'echo %COMPUTERNAME%' | tr -d '\r\n')
  find "$dst" -type f \( -name '*.log' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.ini' -o -name '*.csv' \) -print0 |
    xargs -0 -r sed -i -e "s#$un#USER#Ig" -e "s#$cn#PC#Ig"
}

step() {   # step <name of step> <host> <name> <log folder> [args...]
  local s=$1 host=$2 name=$3 logs=$4; shift 4

  local af=''

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- The menu, the upgrade and wrap screens

bool ASupercutPlayerController::TickMenu(USupercutMenu& Menu)
{
	const bool bWasOpen = Menu.IsOpen();
	int32 Width = 0;
	int32 Height = 0;
	GetViewportSize(Width, Height);

	// The mouse points only when it moves, so a still mouse does not fight the keys. A script points with "point" lines.
	double MouseX = 0.0;
	double MouseY = 0.0;
	const bool bHasMouse = !bScripted && GetMousePosition(MouseX, MouseY);
	const FVector2D Mouse(MouseX, MouseY);
	TOptional<FVector2D> Pointer = ScriptPoint;
	if (bHasMouse && Mouse != LastMenuMouse)
	{
		Pointer = Mouse;
	}
	if (bWasOpen && Pointer.IsSet())
	{
		Menu.PointAt(SupercutMenuView::HitTest(Menu, Width, Height, Pointer.GetValue()));
	}
	LastMenuMouse = Mouse;
	ScriptPoint.Reset();

	// The digits, the point and Backspace type a slider's value; Q E change the settings tab, X resets it, the wheel scrolls it.
	Menu.GetSettings().LastH = Height;
	const bool bShift = IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::LeftShift) || IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::RightShift);
	if (Menu.GetScreen() == ESupercutScreen::Settings && Menu.GetSettings().IsListening())
	{
		// A key box waits: the next key or mouse button goes to it, whatever it is, and nothing else this frame.
		static const TArray<FKey> AllKeys = [] { TArray<FKey> Keys; EKeys::GetAllKeys(Keys); return Keys; }();
		for (const FKey& Key : AllKeys)
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	ASupercutPlayerController();

	virtual void BeginPlay() override;
	virtual void PlayerTick(float DeltaTime) override;

	/** The card under a point of the screen, in pixels, or -1. The HUD uses it to light the card under the mouse. */
	int32 CardAt(const FVector2D& Pixel) const;

	/** True when a person plays with the mouse and keyboard, false for a scripted run. */

	Reload,        // the reload's key and RELOAD over the pips, while an empty cylinder waits for the key

struct FSupercutPromptInput
{
	bool bPlaying = false;         // in play: a live player, no menu, no screen between rooms

{

	const TArray<FSupercutCredit>& Credits = SupercutCredits::Get();
	const FVector2D Sizes[] = { FVector2D(1920.f, 1080.f), FVector2D(1280.f, 720.f) };

	const FSupercutUiPainter::FShape* HudFillAt(const FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, const FBox2D& Box)

		}

Lift 0 to 1 brightens the edge and fills the key cap; Flash lays Chalk over it.\n\t */\n\tvoid ScreensCard(FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, const FSupercutUpgradeCardText& Text, int32 Index, const FBox2D& Card, float Lift, float Flash)\n\t{\n\t\tconst FSupercutUiStyle& Style = Painter.Style;\n\t\tconst float H = Painter.H;\n\t\tconst float U = CardU(Card);\n\t\tconst FBox2D Shadow = Card.ShiftBy(FVector2D(CardShadowDropH * H * 0.35f, CardShadowDropH * H));\n\t\tPainter.Glow(Shadow, CardShadowGlowH * H, FLinearColor(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, CardShadowAlpha * 0.6f));\n\t\tPainter.Fill(Shadow, FLinearColor(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, CardShadowAlpha));\n\t\tPainter.Fill(Card, CardBody);\n\t\tPainter.Polygon({ Card.Min, FVector2D(Card.Max.X, Card.Min.Y), FVector2D(Card.Max.X, Card.GetCenter().Y), FVector2D(Card.Min.X, Card.GetCenter().Y) },\n\t\t\t{ Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.06f), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.06f), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.f), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.f) });\n\t\tPainter.InnerShade(Card, CardShadeU * U, FLinearColor(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, CardShadeAlpha));\n\t\tPainter.ClapperStripes(SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeBand(Card), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.85f));\n\n\t\tconst FBox2D Plate = SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeIconPlate(Card);\n\t\tPainter.Fill(Plate, CardPlate);\n\t\tPainter.InnerShade(Plate, Plate.GetSize().X * 0.12f, FLinearColor(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.5f));\n\t\tPainter.Outline(Plate, 1.f, Style.Line());\n\t\tPainter.Image(Plate.ExpandBy(-Plate.GetSize().X * CardIconInset), FSupercutUiStyle::Icon(Text.Key.ToString()), Style.Chalk);\n\n\t\tPainter.Text(Text.Name, SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeNameAt(Card), SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeNameCap(Card), Style.Chalk, ESupercutUiAlign::Centre, ESupercutFont::Display);\n\t\tconst float RuleHalf = Card.GetSize().X * CardRuleWide * 0.5f;\n\t\tconst float RuleY = Card.Min.Y + CardRuleYU * U;\n\t\tPainter.Fill(ScreensBox(CardMidX(Card) - RuleHalf, RuleY, CardMidX(Card) + RuleHalf, RuleY + FMath::Max(1.f, CardRuleU * U)), Style.Accent);\n\t\tfor (const TPair<FString, FVector2D>& Line : SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeFactLines(Card, Text.Fact))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPainter.Text(Line.Key, Line.Value, SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeFactCap(Card), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(CardFactAlpha), ESupercutUiAlign::Centre);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst FBox2D Key = SupercutHudScreens::UpgradeKeyCap(Card);\n\t\tconst bool bKeyLit = Lift >= 0.5f;\n\t\tif (bKeyLit)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPainter.Fill(Key, Style.Accent);\n\t\t}\n\t\telse\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPainter.Outline(Key, FMath::Max(1.f, 0.0015f * H), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.6f));\n\t\t}\n\t\tPainter.Text(FString::FromInt(Index + 1), Key.GetCenter(), Key.GetSize().Y * 0.5f, bKeyLit ? Style.Ink : Style.Chalk, ESupercutUiAlign::Centre);\n\n\t\tPainter.Outline(Card, FMath::Max(1.f, 0.0015f * H * (1.f + Lift)), Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(FMath::Lerp(CardEdgeRest, 1.f, Lift)));\n\t\tif (Flash > 0.f)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPainter.Fill(Card, Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(0.85f * Flash));\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tvoid ScreensUpgradeHint(FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, int32 Count)\n\t{\n\t\tScreensHint(Painter, Count == 3 ? TEXT(\"1 2 3\") : (Count == 2 ? TEXT(\"1 2\") : TEXT(\"1\")), TEXT(\"CHOOSE\"));\n\t}\n}\n\nvoid SupercutHudScreens::DrawUpgrades(FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, const TArray<FSupercutUpgradeCardText>& Cards, const TArray<float>& Lifts, float SinceOpen)\n{\n\tconst float W = Painter.W;\n\tconst float H = Painter.H;\n\tPainter.Fill(ScreensBox(0.f, 0.f, W, H), FLinearColor(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, CardWashAlpha * FMath::Clamp(SinceOpen / CardWashInSeconds, 0.f, 1.f)));\n\tconst float Before = Painter.Alpha;\n\tfor (int32 Index = 0; Index < Cards.Num(); ++Index)\n\t{\n\t\tconst float Deal = (SinceOpen - Index * CardDealGap) / CardDealSeconds;\n\t\tif (Deal <= 0.f)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst float In = SupercutEaseOut(Deal);\n\t\tconst float Lift = Lifts.IsValidIndex(Index) ? FMath::Clamp(Lifts[Index], 0.f, 1.f) : 0.f;\n\t\tconst FBox2D Card = CardScaled(UpgradeCard(Index, Cards.Num(), W, H), 1.f + CardLiftScale * Lift, (1.f - In) * CardDealDropH * H - Lift * CardLiftUpH * H);\n\t\tPainter.Alpha = Before * In;\n\t\tScreensCard(Painter, Cards[Index], Index, Card, Lift, 0.f);\n\t}\n\tPainter.Alpha = Before;\n\tScreensUpgradeHint(Painter, Cards.Num());\n}\n\nvoid SupercutHudScreens::DrawUpgradesLeaving(FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, const TArray<FSupercutUpgradeCardText>& Cards, int32 Chosen, float SinceChosen)\n{\n\tif (SinceChosen >= CardLeaveSeconds)\n\t{\n\t\treturn;\n\t}\n\tconst float W = Painter.W;\n\tconst float H = Painter.H;\n\tconst float Out = FMath::Clamp((SinceChosen - CardFlashSeconds) / (CardLeaveSeconds - CardFlashSeconds), 0.f, 1.f);\n\tPainter.Fill(ScreensBox(0.f, 0.f, W, H), FLinearColor(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, CardWashAlpha * (1.f - Out)));\n\tconst float Before = Painter.Alpha;\n\tconst float Fall = FMath::Clamp(SinceChosen / CardFlashSeconds, 0.f, 1.f);\n\tfor (int32 Index = 0; Index < Cards.Num(); ++Index)\n\t{\n\t\tconst FBox2D Rest = UpgradeCard(Index, Cards.Num(), W, H);\n\t\tif (Index == Chosen)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPainter.Alpha = Before * (1.f - Out);\n\t\t\tScreensCard(Painter, Cards[Index], Index, CardScaled(Rest, 1.f + CardLiftScale, -CardLiftUpH * H), 1.f, 1.f - Fall);\n\t\t}\n\t\telse if (Fall < 1.f)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t// The others fall away: down and smaller, fading out.\n\t\t\tPainter.Alpha = Before * (1.f - Fall);\n\t\t\tScreensCard(Painter, Cards[Index], Index, CardScaled(Rest, 1.f - 0.06f * Fall, SupercutEaseIn(Fall) * 0.10f * H), 0.f, 0.f);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tPainter.Alpha = Before;\n}"

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "GameFramework/HUD.h"
#include "SupercutHUD.generated.h"

class USupercutMenu;
class USupercutRun;

/**
 * Everything drawn over the picture: crosshair, health, rounds, clapperboard charges, the bar that
 * drains during a freeze, the freeze picture's letterbox bars and flash, the scene and take numbers,
 * the upgrade screen, the wrap screen, and the title, pause, settings and controls screens (USupercutMenu).
 * Drawn straight onto the canvas, with no widget assets.
 * It runs in real time, frozen or paused.
 */
UCLASS()
class ASupercutHUD : public AHUD
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	virtual void DrawHUD() override;

	/**
	 * Where card Index of Count sits on the upgrade screen, in pixels of a W by H screen.
	 * The player controller tests mouse clicks against the same rectangle that is drawn.
	 */
	static FBox2D CardRect(int32 Index, int32 Count, float W, float H);

private:
	void Label(const FString& Text, float X, float Y, float Size, const FLinearColor& Color, bool bCentre);
	void DrawUpgradeScreen(const USupercutRun& Run, float W, float H, float S);
	void DrawWrapScreen(const USupercutRun& Run, float W, float H, float S);
	void DrawMenu(const USupercutMenu& Menu, float W, float H, float S);
	/** VIDEO's PERFORMANCE OVERLAY, over everything, on every screen. */
	void DrawOverlay(float W, float H);
	/** Tuning.txt's bad lines and TUNED count; the practice keys' lines (NO DAMAGE, the last key's answer, the key list). */
	void DrawTuningAndPractice(float W, float H, float S, float Top);

	float Bars = 0.f;   // 0 = no letterbox, 1 = bars fully closed
	float OverlayFrameSeconds = 0.f;   // the real frame time, smoothed, for the performance overlay
	int32 LastMarkerDrawn = 0;   // GetMarkersStarted when a marker was last drawn, so the log notes each new one once

	static constexpr double TuningProblemSeconds = 8.0;   // how long Tuning.txt's bad lines stay on screen after a read
	int32 ShownTuningLoad = 0;      // the tuning read whose bad lines are on screen
	double TuningShownSince = 0.0;  // world real time of the first frame that drew them
};

{
	bool bPlayer = false;            // a player character exists: health and rounds are drawn

	float SinceChargeGained = 1000.f;
	float SinceRefusedClap = 1000.f;
	float SinceChargeSpent = 1000.f; // seconds since the shown count last dropped (FSupercutChargeWatch)
	float ChipHealth = 0.f;          // the lighter chip behind the health fill: lingers at the health lost, then drains (FSupercutHealthChip)
	int32 Rounds = 0;
	int32 MaxRounds = 0;
	bool bReloading = false;
	float ReloadFraction = 0.f;
	float ChargePulseSeconds = -1.f; // seconds into the Charge back teaching prompt's pulses (FSupercutHudPrompts); below 0 when it is not showing

	float FreezeFraction = 0.f;      // of the freeze left
	float FreezeRemaining = 0.f;
	bool bFreezeWarn = false;        // the last quarter, or the tuning's warning seconds
	int32 Scene = 0;
	int32 Take = 0;
	float SlateSeconds = -1.f;       // seconds since the room start slate began; below 0 when it is not shown
	float SlateHoldSeconds = 1.6f;   // the slate is gone this long after it began
};

	float Value(double Now) const;

	float Top = 0.f;       // where the chip drains from
	double LostAt = -1.0;  // the last loss; below 0 when the chip sits on the health
};

enum class ESupercutRunPhase : uint8
{
	Idle,      // no run has begun (the headless tests of the core start here)
	Title,     // the title screen: the first room stands frozen behind it and the game is paused
	Playing,   // in a room
	Picking,   // at a gate, game paused, choosing an upgrade
	Dead,      // the player died; the next take starts after a short wait
	Wrapped,   // past the last gate, game paused, the run's numbers are on screen
};

def import_texture(source, folder, name, srgb, compression):
    # A PNG or JPG from Art/ as a texture. Wrap, mips on (the engine's defaults for an imported texture).
    path = folder + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path) and not EAL.delete_asset(path):
        raise RuntimeError("could not delete " + path)
    if not os.path.isfile(source):
        raise RuntimeError("missing " + source)
    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
    task.set_editor_property("filename", source)
    task.set_editor_property("destination_path", folder)
    task.set_editor_property("destination_name", name)
    task.set_editor_property("automated", True)
    task.set_editor_property("replace_existing", True)
    task.set_editor_property("save", False)
    TOOLS.import_asset_tasks([task])
    texture = unreal.load_asset(path)
    if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
        raise RuntimeError("import of " + source + " gave " + str(texture))
    texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
    texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
    if not EAL.save_loaded_asset(texture, False):
        raise RuntimeError(path + " not saved")
    return texture


def make_sketch():
    # The frozen-time pencil sketch: a post-process material after tonemapping, one Custom node holding
    # Art/sketchfx/SketchFreeze.hlsl. The two textures are read as numbers, not pictures: linear, Masks compression.
    sketch_dir = os.path.join(PROJECT, "Art", "sketchfx")
    paper = import_texture(os.path.join(sketch_dir, "T_Sketch_Paper.png"), "/Game/Textures", "T_Sketch_Paper", False, unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS)
    hatch = import_texture(os.path.join(sketch_dir, "T_Sketch_Hatch.png"), "/Game/Textures", "T_Sketch_Hatch", False, unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS)
    # Never streamed: a post-process material gives the streamer no screen size to go by, so a streamed texture starts
    # at a low mip and the hatching draws as blocky smears for the first fraction of a second (lane first1). 512x512 each.
    for texture in (paper, hatch):
        texture.set_editor_property("never_stream", True)
        if not EAL.save_loaded_asset(texture, False):
            raise RuntimeError(texture.get_path_name() + " not saved")
    with open(os.path.join(sketch_dir, "SketchFreeze.hlsl"), encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        code = handle.read()

    material = fresh("M_SketchFreeze", "/Game/Materials", unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    material.

int32 UPythonScriptCommandlet::Main(const FString& Params)
{
	// We do this parsing manually rather than using the normal command line parsing, as the Python scripts may be quoted and contain escape sequences that the command line parsing doesn't handle well
	FString PythonScript;
	{
		const FString ScriptTag = TEXT("-Script=");
		const int32 ScriptTagPos = Params.Find(ScriptTag);
		if (ScriptTagPos != INDEX_NONE)
		{
			const TCHAR* ScriptTagValue = &Params[ScriptTagPos + ScriptTag.Len()];
			if (*ScriptTagValue == TEXT('"'))
			{
				FParse::QuotedString(ScriptTagValue, PythonScript);
			}
			else
			{
				FParse::Token(ScriptTagValue, PythonScript, false);
			}
		}
	}
	if (PythonScript.IsEmpty())
	{
		UE_LOGF(LogPythonScriptCommandlet, Error, "-Script argument not specified");
		return -1;
	}

#if WITH_PYTHON
	// We can assume the user wanted Python support enabled when using this commandlet
	IPythonScriptPlugin::Get()->ForceEnablePythonAtRuntime();

	if (!IPythonScriptPlugin::Get()->IsPythonAvailable())
	{
		UE_LOGF(LogPythonScriptCommandlet, Error, "Python script cannot run as Python support is disabled!");
		return -1;
	}

	// Ensure that any start-up scripts have been run
	FPythonScriptPlugin::Get()->RunStartupScripts();

	{
#if WITH_EDITOR
		// Ensure that source control is enabled, as commandlets aren't guaranteed to do that
		FScopedSourceControl SourceControl;
#endif

		UE_LOGF(LogPythonScriptCommandlet, Display, "Running Python script: %ls", *PythonScript);

		FPythonCommandEx PythonCommand;
		PythonCommand.Flags |= EPythonCommandFlags::Unattended;
		PythonCommand.Command = PythonScript;
		if (!IPythonScriptPlugin::Get()->ExecPythonCommandEx(PythonCommand))
		{
			UE_LOGF(LogPythonScriptCommandlet, Error, "Python script executed with errors");
			return -1;
		}
	}

python -I - <<'EOF'
import struct
def caps(p):
    b=open(p,'rb').read()
    n=struct.unpack('>H',b[4:6])[0]; t={}
    for i in range(n):
        tag,cs,off,ln=struct.unpack('>4sIII',b[12+16*i:28+16*i]); t[tag]=off
    em=struct.unpack('>H',b[t[b'head']+18:t[b'head']+20])[0]
    o=t[b'OS/2']; ver=struct.unpack('>H',b[o:o+2])[0]
    cap=struct.unpack('>h',b[o+88:o+90])[0] if ver>=2 else None
    return em,cap
for p in [r'D:/UE/wt/hud2/Art/fonts/barlow/Barlow-Regular.ttf', r'D:/UE/wt/hud2/Art/fonts/barlowcondensed/BarlowCondensed-ExtraBoldItalic.ttf', r'D:/UE/UE_5.9/Engine/Content/Slate/Fonts/Roboto-Bold.ttf']:
    em,cap=caps(p); print(p.split('/')[-1], em, cap, 'size per cap px %.4f'%(em/(cap*96/72)))
EOF

{
 "file_path": "D:\\UE\\wt\\hud2\\Art\\ui_icons\\make_icon_pngs.py",
 "content": "# The HUD's icon pictures (lane hud2), from lane icons1's finals (1024 square PNGs named by key, no alpha):\n#   - the nine upgrade icons are painted pictures on a dark ground that is not exactly flat (about #0e0e0e). Their\n#     colours are kept; the alpha fades out over the last EDGE of the square, a soft-edged mask, so on the card's dark\n#     plate the picture's square edge does not show.\n#   - clap_full is light line art on black: the brightness becomes the alpha of a white picture, so the HUD tints it\n#     (chalk for a charge held, the same picture dimmed for one spent). clap_empty is not used: it is a separate\n#     drawing that does not line up with clap_full, so a spend would jump.\n#\n#   python -I Art\\ui_icons\\make_icon_pngs.py <folder with [a shooter the owner likes]>\n#\n# Writes Art\\ui_icons\\<name>.png, 256 square. Then import them with Tools\\make_ui_icons.py (in the editor, headless).\n# Needs Pillow. The source pictures are only read.\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter\n\nHERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\nPAINTED = [\"longtake\", \"extrareel\", \"slowburn\", \"doubleexposure\", \"stuntdouble\", \"quickchange\", \"throughline\",\n           \"reverseshot\", \"encore\"]\nLINE_ART = [\"clap_full\"]\nSIZE = 256\nEDGE = 0.08          # of the side: the painted icon's alpha goes from 1 to 0 over this band at each edge\n\n\ndef soft_square():\n    # A square that is opaque inside and falls to clear at the edge: an inset rectangle, blurred.\n    band = SIZE * EDGE\n    mask = Image.new(\"L\", (SIZE, SIZE), 0)\n    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rectangle([band * 0.5, band * 0.5, SIZE - 1 - band * 0.5, SIZE - 1 - band * 0.5], fill=255)\n    return mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(band * 0.35))\n\n\ndef main():\n    if len(sys.argv) != 2:\n        raise SystemExit(\"usage: make_icon_pngs.py <folder with [a shooter the owner likes]>\")\n    folder = sys.argv[1]\n    mask = soft_square()\n    for name in PAINTED + LINE_ART:\n        source = os.path.join(folder, name + \".png\")\n        if not os.path.isfile(source):\n            raise SystemExit(\"missing \" + source)\n        picture = Image.open(source).convert(\"RGB\").resize((SIZE, SIZE), Image.LANCZOS)\n        if name in LINE_ART:\n            out = Image.new(\"RGBA\", (SIZE, SIZE), (255, 255, 255, 0))\n            out.putalpha(picture.convert(\"L\"))\n        else:\n            out = picture.convert(\"RGBA\")\n            out.putalpha(mask)\n        out.save(os.path.join(HERE, name + \".png\"))\n        print(\"icon\", name, \"line art: brightness as alpha\" if name in LINE_ART else \"painted: colours kept, soft-edged mask\")\n\n\nmain()\n"
}

void ASupercutCharacter::ForgetClapForTests()
{
	bClappedThisProgramRun = false;
}

bool ASupercutCharacter::Clap()
{
	if (bDead)
	{
		return false;
	}
	if (ClapMotion.IsBusy(FSupercutTuning::Get()))
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("CLAP press %.3f s into the clap does nothing"), ClapMotion.GetClock());
		return false;
	}
	const bool bChanged = USupercutTime::Get(this).PressClapper();
	if (bChanged && !bClappedThisProgramRun)
	{
		bClappedThisProgramRun = true;
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("ONBOARD first clap of this program run: the RIGHT MOUSE prompt goes"));
	}
	if (!bChanged)
	{
		// No charges left: the board comes up, jams and drops (FSupercutClapMotion). The jam sounds clap_empty.
		ClapMotion.StartRefused();
		ClapSoundHook(TEXT("lift_whoosh"));
	}
	return bChanged;
}

import struct
def load(p):
    b=open(p,'rb').read(); n=struct.unpack('>H',b[4:6])[0]; t={}
    for i in range(n):
        tag,cs,off,ln=struct.unpack('>4sIII',b[12+16*i:28+16*i]); t[tag]=off
    em=struct.unpack('>H',b[t[b'head']+18:t[b'head']+20])[0]
    nh=struct.unpack('>H',b[t[b'hhea']+34:t[b'hhea']+36])[0]
    adv=[struct.unpack('>H',b[t[b'hmtx']+4*i:t[b'hmtx']+4*i+2])[0] for i in range(nh)]
    c=t[b'cmap']; nt=struct.unpack('>H',b[c+2:c+4])[0]; cmap={}
    for i in range(nt):
        pid,eid,off=struct.unpack('>HHI',b[c+4+8*i:c+12+8*i])
        o=c+off; fmt=struct.unpack('>H',b[o:o+2])[0]
        if fmt==4 and pid==3:
            seg=struct.unpack('>H',b[o+6:o+8])[0]//2
            ends=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg,b[o+14:o+14+2*seg]); s0=o+16+2*seg
            starts=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg,b[s0:s0+2*seg]); d0=s0+2*seg
            deltas=struct.unpack('>%dh'%seg,b[d0:d0+2*seg]); r0=d0+2*seg
            ros=struct.unpack('>%dH'%seg,b[r0:r0+2*seg])
            for k in range(seg):
                for ch in range(starts[k],min(ends[k],0x7f)+1):
                    if ros[k]==0: g=(ch+deltas[k])&0xffff
                    else:
                        a=r0+2*k+ros[k]+2*(ch-starts[k]); g=struct.unpack('>H',b[a:a+2])[0]
                        if g: g=(g+deltas[k])&0xffff
                    cmap[ch]=g
            break
    return em,adv,cmap
def width(f,s,size):
    em,adv,cmap=f; return sum(adv[min(cmap.get(ord(ch),0),len(adv)-1)] for ch in s)/em*size*96/72
T=load(r'D:/UE/wt/hud2/Art/fonts/barlow/Barlow-Regular.ttf'); D=load(r'D:/UE/wt/hud2/Art/fonts/barlowcondensed/BarlowCondensed-ExtraBoldItalic.ttf')

names=["LONG TAKE","EXTRA REEL","SLOW BURN","DOUBLE EXPOSURE","STUNT DOUBLE","QUICK CHANGE","THROUGH LINE","REVERSE SHOT","ENCORE"]
for H in (1080,720):
    U=0.5*H; cardw=0.3*H; cap=0.031*U; size=round(cap*1.071)/1.0
    room=cardw*0.84
    worst=0
    for f in facts:
        lines=[]
        for wd in f.split(' '):
            if lines and width(T,lines[-1]+' '+wd,size)<=room: lines[-1]+=' '+wd
            else: lines.append(wd)
        worst=max(worst,len(lines))
        if len(lines)>3: print(H,'TOO MANY',lines)
    nsize=round(0.052*U*1.071)
    print(H,'fact size',size,'room',round(room),'max lines',worst,'| widest name %.0f of %.0f'%(max(width(D,n,nsize) for n in names),cardw*0.92))
    print(H,'WALK INTO A FROZEN SHOT text width %.0f'%width(T,"WALK INTO A FROZEN SHOT",round(0.020*H*1.071)))
EOF

    step "$verb" "$@" ;;
  fetch)
    [ $# -eq 4 ] || { echo "usage: farm.sh fetch <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>" >&2; exit 64; }
    root=$(fwd "$(root_of "$1")") || exit $?
    case "$3" in
      builds/*) src="$root/Farm/_builds/$2/${3#builds/}" ;;
      out/*)    src="$root/Farm/_out/$2/${3#out/}" ;;
      *)        src="$root/Farm/$2/$3" ;;
    esac
    pull "$1" "$src" "$4" ;;
  status)

    root=$(root_of "$1") || exit $?

$line = "$root\Farm\hud2\Supercut.uproject -run=pythonscript -Script=`"$script $ScriptArgs`" -AllowCommandletRendering -unattended -nopause -nosplash -nosound -abslog=$log"

"EXIT $($p.ExitCode)"

IMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_AUTOMATION_TEST(FSupercutHudCardsStampTest, "Supercut.Hud.TheStampSitsClearOfTheRoomSlateTheCrosshairAndThePrompts", HudCardsTestFlags)
bool FSupercutHudCardsStampTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	for (const FVector2D& Size : HudCardsSizes)
	{
		const float W = Size.X;
		const float H = Size.Y;
		const FString At = FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f: "), H);
		for (const TCHAR* Word : { TEXT("ACTION!"), TEXT("CUT!") })
		{
			// The stamp pops from 1.5 times its size: test at the biggest.
			FSupercutUiPainter Painter(nullptr, W, H, 0.0);
			SupercutHudView::DrawStamp(Painter, Word, 1.5f, FLinearColor::White);
			const FSupercutUiPainter::FTextShape* Stamp = Painter.Texts.FindByPredicate([&](const FSupercutUiPainter::FTextShape& Text) { return Text.String == Word; });
			if (!TestNotNull(At + FString::Printf(TEXT("%s drawn"), Word), Stamp))
			{
				continue;
			}
			TestFalse(At + FString::Printf(TEXT("%s clear of the SCENE TAKE slate (qa1 B5)"), Word), Stamp->Box.Intersect(SupercutHudView::RoomSlatePlate(W, H)));
			TestTrue(At + FString::Printf(TEXT("%s ends %.0f px above the crosshair"), Word, 0.5f * H - Stamp->Box.Max.Y), Stamp->Box.Max.Y < 0.47f * H);
			TestTrue(At + FString::Printf(TEXT("%s on the screen"), Word), Stamp->Box.Min.X > 0.f && Stamp->Box.Max.X < W);
			TestTrue(At + FString::Printf(TEXT("%s centred"), Word), HudCardsNear(Stamp->Box.GetCenter().X, 0.5f * W, 1.5f));
		}
		// At rest the stamp is today's size: 64 px of the display font at 720p.
		TestTrue(At + TEXT("today's size"), HudCardsNear(FSupercutUiPainter::FontSize(SupercutHudView::StampCap(H), ESupercutFont::Display), 64.f / 720.f * H, 0.5f));
	}
	return true;
}

void SupercutHudView::DrawRoomSlate(FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, const FSupercutHudState& State)
{
	if (State.SlateSeconds < 0.f)
	{
		return;
	}

float FSupercutUiPainter::FontSize(float Cap, ESupercutFont Face)
{
	return Cap * FSupercutUiStyle::Get().SlotOf(Face).SizePerCapPx;
}

namespace
{
	FSlateFontInfo UiFontInfo(float Cap, ESupercutFont Face)
	{
		// A canvas text item only draws a Slate font when the font info holds a UFont.
		return FSlateFontInfo(&FSupercutUiStyle::Font(Face), FMath::RoundToInt(FSupercutUiPainter::FontSize(Cap, Face)), FName(FSupercutUiStyle::Get().SlotOf(Face).Typeface));
	}
}

float FSupercutUiPainter::TextWidth(const FString& String, float Cap, ESupercutFont Face)
{
	const TSharedPtr<FSlateFontMeasure> Measure = FEngineFontServices::Get().GetFontMeasure();
	checkf(Measure.IsValid(), TEXT("FSupercutUiPainter::TextWidth: the engine has no font measure service"));
	return float(FVector2D(Measure->Measure(String, UiFontInfo(Cap, Face))).X);
}

void FSupercutUiPainter::Image(const FBox2D& InBox, UTexture2D& Texture, const FLinearColor& InColor)
{
	const FBox2D Box = InBox.ShiftBy(Offset);
	const FLinearColor Color = InColor.CopyWithNewOpacity(InColor.A * Alpha);
	Images.Add({ Texture.GetName(), Box, Color });
	if (Canvas && Color.A > 0.f)
	{
		checkf(Texture.GetResource(), TEXT("FSupercutUiPainter::Image: %s has no render resource"), *Texture.GetName());
		FCanvasTileItem Tile(Box.Min, Texture.GetResource(), Box.GetSize(), Color);
		Tile.BlendMode = SE_BLEND_Translucent;
		Canvas->DrawItem(Tile);
	}
}

TArray<FString> FFreeTypeFace::GetAvailableSubFaces(const FFreeTypeLibrary* InFTLibrary, FFontFaceDataConstRef InMemory)
{
	TArray<FString> Result;

#if WITH_FREETYPE
	FT_Face FTFace = nullptr;
	FT_New_Memory_Face(InFTLibrary->GetLibrary(), InMemory->GetData().GetData(), static_cast<FT_Long>(InMemory->GetData().Num()), -1, &FTFace);
	if (FTFace)
	{
		const int32 NumFaces = FTFace->num_faces;
		FT_Done_Face(FTFace);
		FTFace = nullptr;

		Result.Reserve(NumFaces);
		for (int32 FaceIndex = 0; FaceIndex < NumFaces; ++FaceIndex)
		{
			FT_New_Memory_Face(InFTLibrary->GetLibrary(), InMemory->GetData().GetData(), static_cast<FT_Long>(InMemory->GetData().Num()), FaceIndex, &FTFace);
			if (FTFace)
			{
				Result.Add(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s (%s)"), UTF8_TO_TCHAR(FTFace->family_name), UTF8_TO_TCHAR(FTFace->style_name)));
				FT_Done_Face(FTFace);
				FTFace = nullptr;
			}
		}

 "file_path": "D:\\UE\\wt\\hud2\\Art\\ui_icons\\make_icon_pngs.py",
 "content": "# The HUD's icon pictures (lane hud2), from lane icons1's finals: 1024 square PNGs named by key, no alpha, light line\n# art on black (the owner's black and white set, 15 Nov). The brightness becomes the alpha of a white picture, so the\n# HUD draws it over its own dark plate, untinted on the cards, tinted on the clapperboard counter (chalk for a charge\n# held, the same picture dimmed for one spent). clap_empty is not used: its board sits about 1 px off clap_full's at the\n# counter's size, so a spend would jump; the spent state is clap_full dimmed in place.\n#\n#   python -I Art\\ui_icons\\make_icon_pngs.py <folder with [a shooter the owner likes]>\n#\n# Writes Art\\ui_icons\\<name>.png, 256 square. Then import them with Tools\\make_ui_icons.py (in the editor, headless).\n# Needs Pillow. The source pictures are only read.\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nHERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\nNAMES = [\"longtake\", \"extrareel\", \"slowburn\", \"doubleexposure\", \"stuntdouble\", \"quickchange\", \"throughline\",\n         \"reverseshot\", \"encore\", \"clap_full\"]\nSIZE = 256\n\n\ndef main():\n    if len(sys.argv) != 2:\n        raise SystemExit(\"usage: make_icon_pngs.py <folder with [a shooter the owner likes]>\")\n    folder = sys.argv[1]\n    for name in NAMES:\n        source = os.path.join(folder, name + \".png\")\n        if not os.path.isfile(source):\n            raise SystemExit(\"missing \" + source)\n        picture = Image.open(source).convert(\"L\").resize((SIZE, SIZE), Image.LANCZOS)\n        out = Image.new(\"RGBA\", (SIZE, SIZE), (255, 255, 255, 0))\n        out.putalpha(picture)\n        out.save(os.path.join(HERE, name + \".png\"))\n        print(\"icon\", name, \"line art: brightness as alpha\")\n\n\nmain()\n"
}

def name(b,t,nid):

    b,t=tables(f)
    em=struct.unpack('>H',b[t['head'][0]+18:t['head'][0]+20])[0]
    o=t['OS/2'][0]; ver=struct.unpack('>H',b[o:o+2])[0]; cap=struct.unpack('>h',b[o+88:o+90])[0] if ver>=2 else None

        nm=name(b,t,sn)

### Sun 15 Nov 14:34:19 · Agent (claude-opus-5-5)

hud2 is paused on the fonts: the owner's two picks need static font files that I can't make here, so I'm stopping as your 14:21 message asked. Nothing of mine is running on the farm, and nothing is committed yet. All the work is in `D:\UE\wt\hud2`.

**What I need from you:** two static font files with the OFL name table kept and the family names unchanged.
- `Exo2-BlackItalic.ttf`, made from `Exo2-Italic[wght].ttf` at wght 900.
- `Saira-Regular.ttf`, made from `Saira[wdth,wght].ttf` at wght 400, wdth 100.

Put them in `lanes\font1\fonts\exo2\` and `lanes\font1\fonts\saira\`, or anywhere you tell me.

**Why the variable files won't work**
- UE 5.9 only ever draws a variable font at its default instance. Its sub-face list counts only the faces in the file, never named instances (FontCacheFreeType.cpp:538-563), and the importer makes a single typeface (EditorFactories.cpp:5326).
- The defaults are Exo 2 Italic at weight 400 and Saira Thin, so neither would look like the pick.
- UE's FreeType 2.14.1 does support variable fonts (ftoption.h:738). But the field that would select a named instance, `FFontData::SubFaceIndex`, is a bare `UPROPERTY()` (CompositeFont.h:282). Python and the font editor can't set it. Poking it from C++ at load is too hacky to ship, so I didn't.
- fontTools is not installed in any Python I may use: c4 (its own Pythons plus UE 5.9's and 5.8's), [pc-c], pc2 and pc4. pc3 didn't answer ssh.

**Done so far**
- **Farm:** moved to [pc-c] after [pc-b] dropped out. The mirror, build and Python imports work there.
- **Two script fixes:**
  - The editor's `-Script="..."` parser treats backslashes as escapes, so `F:\UE\Farm` turned into `F:\Farm`. My run script now passes forward slashes.
  - Two `Printf` calls passed `*Upgrade.Name` where `Name` is already a `const TCHAR*`. Fixed.
- **Tests:** with the Barlow pair and the first icon set, all 247 pass (the 239 before plus my 8 new ones). Two first-run failures were fixed without loosening any test:
  - The plates' soft shadow drew mitred polygons, which the "nothing is rounded" test rejects. It is now a hard offset shadow.
  - My new stamp test was measuring HUD text's dark copy instead of the face.
- **New black and white icons:**
  - All ten are re-imported on [pc-c] and fetched back.
  - Every icon now becomes white line art over its own dark plate, because without one they disappear on a bright wall.
  - clap_full alone still covers both counter states. The new clap_full and clap_empty boards sit about 1 px apart at counter size, so a spend would jump.
  - The closest pair at 64 px is LONG TAKE and EXTRA REEL (both reels). `[taste: owner review]`
- **Fonts:** Barlow's files and assets are gone from the branch. The slots already name `/Game/UI/Fonts/Exo2BlackItalic_Font` and `SairaRegular_Font`. Both families' `OFL.txt` are in `Art/fonts/exo2/` and `Art/fonts/saira/`, and ship from there.
- **Fit pre-check, measured against Barlow:** names fit and every fact wraps to 3 lines or fewer at both 1080p and 720p. Exo 2 and Saira will be measured again once imported.

**Once the files arrive, about an hour:**
1. Import both fonts and recheck their size settings.
2. Build and run all tests.
3. Make the Development package.
4. Run main8 twice and s7 once, then the 10 picture runs, with `tools/run_all.sh [pc-c] all`.
5. Commit and finish HANDOFF.md, which already has a status section saying all of this.

**Proposed credits lines:**
- "Exo 2 by The Exo 2 Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1"
- "Saira by The Saira Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1"

**SUBMISSION.md rows:** for each family, "font, Google Fonts (github.com/googlefonts/Exo-2.0 / github.com/Omnibus-Type/Saira), OFL 1.1, OFL.txt shipped". In the package, each `OFL.txt` goes beside the game's other licence texts, in a `Licenses/<family>/` folder.

{
 "file_path": "[notes]\\unreal\\megajam-2026\\lanes\\hud2\\tools\\shots_to_jpg.py",
 "content": "# hud2: the picture runs' PNG shots (D:\\UE\\wt\\hud2_farmlogs\\runs\\<run>\\shots) as JPG at most 960 wide in\n# lanes\\hud2\\shots\\<run>\\, plus a strip sheet per run for the strips (deal, flash, spend, hit, room 4 start).\n#   python -I shots_to_jpg.py\nimport os\n\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nRUNS = r\"D:\\UE\\wt\\hud2_farmlogs\\runs\"\nOUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), \"..\", \"shots\")\nSTRIPS = {\"c_deal_\": \"deal\", \"c_flash_\": \"flash\", \"k_spend_\": \"spend\", \"h_hit_\": \"hit\", \"g_r04_start_\": \"r04_start\"}\n\nfor run in sorted(os.listdir(RUNS)):\n    shots = os.path.join(RUNS, run, \"shots\")\n    if not os.path.isdir(shots) or not os.listdir(shots):\n        continue\n    dest = os.path.join(OUT, run)\n    os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)\n    names = sorted(n for n in os.listdir(shots) if n.lower().endswith(\".png\"))\n    for n in names:\n        im = Image.open(os.path.join(shots, n)).convert(\"RGB\")\n        if im.width > 960:\n            im = im.resize((960, round(im.height * 960 / im.width)), Image.LANCZOS)\n        im.save(os.path.join(dest, n[:-4] + \".jpg\"), quality=88)\n    for prefix, label in STRIPS.items():\n        strip = [n for n in names if n.startswith(prefix)]\n        if not strip:\n            continue\n        cols = 4\n        tw = 240\n        first = Image.open(os.path.join(shots, strip[0]))\n        th = round(first.height * tw / first.width)\n        rows = (len(strip) + cols - 1) // cols\n        sheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (cols * tw, rows * th), (0, 0, 0))\n        for i, n in enumerate(strip):\n            sheet.paste(Image.open(os.path.join(shots, n)).convert(\"RGB\").resize((tw, th), Image.LANCZOS), ((i % cols) * tw, (i // cols) * th))\n        sheet.save(os.path.join(dest, \"strip_\" + label + \".jpg\"), quality=85)\n    print(run, len(names), \"shots\")\n"
}

bool ASupercutHUD::HidesPlayHud(bool bDead, ESupercutRunPhase Phase, float SincePick)
{
	const bool bLeaving = Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Playing && SincePick >= 0.f && SincePick < SupercutHudScreens::CardLeaveSeconds;
	return bDead || Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Dead || Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Picking || Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Wrapped || bLeaving;
}

void ASupercutHUD::DrawUpgradeScreen(const USupercutRun& Run, float W, float H, float S)
{
	// The card under the mouse (or a script's pointer) lifts; the others settle back.
	const ASupercutPlayerController* Controller = Cast<ASupercutPlayerController>(GetOwningPlayerController());

	FSupercutUiPainter Painter(Canvas, W, H, GetWorld()->GetRealTimeSeconds());
	SupercutHudScreens::DrawUpgrades(Painter, ShownCards, Lifts, Run.GetSecondsInPhase());
}

 "\t\tCardLifts[Card] = Run.GetSecondsInPhase() < RenderDelta ? 0.f : FMath::Clamp(CardLifts[Card] + (Card == Hover ? Step : -Step), 0.f, 1.f);\r\n",

bool FSupercutHudCardsAssetsTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	const FSupercutUiStyle& Style = FSupercutUiStyle::Get();
	for (const ESupercutFont Face : { ESupercutFont::Display, ESupercutFont::Text })
	{
		const FSupercutUiFontSlot& Slot = Style.SlotOf(Face);
		const FString What = Face == ESupercutFont::Display ? TEXT("display font") : TEXT("text font");
		const UFont& Font = FSupercutUiStyle::Font(Face);
		TestEqual(What + TEXT(" is its slot's asset"), Font.GetPathName(), FString(Slot.Asset));
		const bool bTypeface = Font.CompositeFont.DefaultTypeface.Fonts.ContainsByPredicate([&](const FTypefaceEntry& Entry) { return Entry.Name == FName(Slot.Typeface); });
		TestTrue(What + FString::Printf(TEXT(" has the typeface %s"), Slot.Typeface), bTypeface);
		TestTrue(What + TEXT(": its size per cap pixel is set"), Slot.SizePerCapPx > 0.5f && Slot.SizePerCapPx < 2.f);
		TestTrue(What + TEXT(" measures text"), FSupercutUiPainter::TextWidth(TEXT("SUPERCUT"), 20.f, Face) > 20.f);
	}
	TArray<FString> Names = { TEXT("clap_full") };
	for (const FSupercutUpgrade& Upgrade : SupercutUpgrades::All())
	{
		Names.Add(Upgrade.Key.ToString());
	}
	TestEqual(TEXT("nine upgrades and the clapperboard"), Names.Num(), 10);
	for (const FString& Name : Names)
	{
		const FString Path = FString::Printf(TEXT("/Game/UI/Icons/T_Icon_%s.T_Icon_%s"), *Name, *Name);
		const UTexture2D* Texture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr, *Path);

			TestEqual(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is in the UI texture group"), *Name), int32(Texture->LODGroup), int32(TEXTUREGROUP_UI));

			TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is sRGB"), *Name), Texture->SRGB);
		}
	}
	return true;
}

# hud2: run one editor Python script headless in a farm PC's hud2 mirror and wait for it (after flats1's run_py.ps1).
# -Name is the script's name only; -Where Tools runs the mirror's Tools\<Name>.py, -Where Lane runs <root>\Farm\_out\hud2\<Name>.py.
# -ScriptArgs (optional, no spaces inside each word) go to the script's sys.argv: the commandlet reads -Script="<file> <args>".
# <root> comes from this file's own place, <root>\Farm\_out\hud2: C:\UE on [pc-b].
#   ssh [pc-b] "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:/UE/Farm/_out/hud2/run_py.ps1 -Name make_ui_icons -Where Tools"
# Log: <root>\Farm\_out\hud2\py\<Name>.log
param([string]$Name, [ValidateSet('Tools', 'Lane')][string]$Where, [string]$ScriptArgs = '')
$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\..')).Path
$exe = "$root\UE_5.9\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe"
if ($Where -eq 'Tools') { $script = "$root\Farm\hud2\Tools\$Name.py" } else { $script = "$root\Farm\_out\hud2\$Name.py" }
$log = "$root\Farm\_out\hud2\py\$Name.log"
if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { throw "no $script" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $log) | Out-Null
# -Script="..." is read by FParse::QuotedString (Core/Private/Misc/Parse.cpp:381), which takes backslash escapes: the
# "\UE" of F:\UE\Farm vanished. So the script path and its arguments go with forward slashes.
$scriptFwd = $script.Replace('\', '/')
$argsFwd = $ScriptArgs.Replace('\', '/')
$line = "$root\Farm\hud2\Supercut.uproject -run=pythonscript -Script=`"$scriptFwd $argsFwd`" -AllowCommandletRendering -unattended -nopause -nosplash -nosound -abslog=$log"
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $line -Wait -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
"EXIT $($p.ExitCode)"
True
True
10

{
	return (SupercutHudView::RoundPip(0, State.MaxRounds, W, H).Min.X + SupercutHudView::RoundPip(State.MaxRounds - 1, State.MaxRounds, W, H).Max.X) * 0.5f;
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# hud2: the proof runs and the picture runs on the farm, one after another (never two of ours at once).
# Each run's logs land in $L/runs/<name>/ (the farm step replaces $L/run every time).
#   bash run_all.sh <host> [proof|pictures|all]      e.g. bash run_all.sh [pc-c] all
set -u
H=${1:?host}
WHAT=${2:-all}
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
L=/d/UE/wt/hud2_farmlogs
EXE='{B}\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe'
mkdir -p "$L/runs"

one() {   # one <name> <run_demo.ps1 arguments...>
  local name=$1; shift
  local s; s=$(date +%s)
  "$F" run "$H" hud2 "$L" -Packaged -Exe "$EXE" -TimeoutSeconds 540 "$@" > "$L/run_console_$name.txt" 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  rm -rf "$L/runs/$name"; mv "$L/run" "$L/runs/$name"
  mv "$L/run_console_$name.txt" "$L/runs/$name/farm_console.txt"
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) $name rc=$rc $(( $(date +%s)-s ))s | $(grep -h 'RUN wrapped' "$L/runs/$name/run.log" 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/.*(RUN wrapped)/\1/' | head -1)"
}

if [ "$WHAT" = proof ] || [ "$WHAT" = all ]; then
  one main8_a -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent
  one main8_b -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent

**Sun 15 Nov 18:36:27 · Tool call: Bash** (Write the hud3 picture conversion tool)

```
mkdir -p "[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/hud3/tools"; cat > "[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/hud3/tools/shots_to_jpg.py" <<'EOF'
# hud3: the picture run's PNG shots as JPG at most 960 wide in lanes\hud3\shots\, a strip of the turn, and the sheet of
# the old rounds (hud2's six pips) against the new cylinder at true size (1:1 pixels from the 1920x1080 shots).
#   python -I shots_to_jpg.py <folder of the run's PNG shots>
import os
import sys

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

SHOTS = sys.argv[1]
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "shots")
OLD = r"D:\UE\wt\hud2_farmlogs\runs\charges_1080\shots\k_all.png"   # hud2, full cylinder, 1920x1080
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)


def jpg(image, name):
    if image.width > 960:
        image = image.resize((960, round(image.height * 960 / image.width)), Image.LANCZOS)
    image.convert("RGB").save(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".jpg"), quality=90)


names = sorted(n[:-4] for n in os.listdir(SHOTS) if n.endswith(".png"))
for name in names:
    jpg(Image.open(os.path.join(SHOTS, name + ".png")), name)

# The bottom right corner at true size: 1920x1080 pixels 1580-1920 x 880-1080.
BOX = (1580, 880, 1920, 1080)
turn = [n for n in names if n.startswith("t_")]
strip = Image.new("RGB", ((BOX[2] - BOX[0]) // 2 * len(turn), (BOX[3] - BOX[1]) // 2 + 20), (20, 20, 20))
d = ImageDraw.Draw(strip)
for i, name in enumerate(turn):
    crop = Image.open(os.path.join(SHOTS, name + ".png")).crop(BOX)
    strip.paste(crop.resize((crop.width // 2, crop.height // 2), Image.LANCZOS), (i * crop.width // 2, 20))
    d.text((i * crop.width // 2 + 4, 4), name, fill=(240, 240, 240))
jpg(strip, "strip_turn")

old = Image.open(OLD).crop(BOX)
new = Image.open(os.path.join(SHOTS, "f_full.png")).crop(BOX)
sheet = Image.new("RGB", (old.width * 2 + 30, old.height + 24), (20, 20, 20))
d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
sheet.paste(old, (10, 20))
sheet.paste(new, (old.width + 20, 20))
d.text((14, 4), "old: six pips (hud2), 1:1 at 1920x1080", fill=(240, 240, 240))
d.text((old.width + 24, 4), "new: the cylinder, 1:1 at 1920x1080", fill=(240, 240, 240))
sheet.save(os.path.join(OUT, "sheet_old_vs_new_true_size.jpg"), quality=92)
print("wrote", len(names), "shots, strip_turn, sheet_old_vs_new_true_size to", os.path.abspath(OUT))
EOF
echo ok

#   farm.sh status  <host>
#   farm.sh slots                                             who holds or waits for which PC right now
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
#
# Hosts: [pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4 over ssh, and c4 itself (15 Nov: the owner freed c4 for lanes). On c4 nothing is
# copied: "mirror" makes D:\UE\Farm\<name> a junction to the project folder, so the steps build in that folder.
#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one
# when all are taken, so the lanes no longer pile onto one PC. A slot whose farm.sh has died is taken over.
set -u
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)

root_of() {   # one line per farm PC: ssh alias, root folder there (engine in <root>\UE_5.9, mirrors in <root>\Farm)
  case "$1" in

"""farm mirror: make <root>/Farm/<name> on a farm PC match a project folder on c4.

Sends only files whose size or modified time differ (tar keeps the times, so the next build is incremental), never
sends Intermediate, Binaries, Saved, DerivedDataCache or .git, and deletes files under Source, Content, Config, Tools
and Script that no longer exist on c4. Usage: python -I mirror.py <host> <root> <name> <project folder on c4>
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

SKIP = {"Intermediate", "Binaries", "Saved", "DerivedDataCache", ".git"}
PRUNE = ("Source/", "Content/", "Config/", "Tools/", "Script/")
TAR = r"C:\Windows\System32\tar.exe"


def ssh(host, cmd, data=None):
    r = subprocess.run(["ssh", host, cmd], input=data, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f"FARM ssh {host} failed ({r.returncode}): {cmd}\n{r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')}")
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")


def main():
    host, root, name, proj = sys.argv[1:5]
    proj = os.path.abspath(proj)
    if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(proj, "Supercut.uproject")):
        sys.exit(f"FARM no Supercut.uproject in {proj}")
    dest = f"{root}\\Farm\\{name}"

FVector2D SupercutHudView::CylinderCentre(float W, float H)
{
	return FVector2D(RoundsRightW * W - ReloadRingOuterH * H, CylinderCentreY * H);
}

float SupercutHudView::CylinderRadius(float H)
{
	return CylinderRadiusH * H;
}

FBox2D SupercutHudView::CylinderBox(float W, float H)
{
	const FVector2D Centre = CylinderCentre(W, H);
	const FVector2D Extent(ReloadRingOuterH * H, ReloadRingOuterH * H);
	return FBox2D(Centre - Extent, Centre + Extent);
}

float SupercutHudView::ChamberRadius(float H)
{
	return ChamberRadiusH * H;
}

float SupercutHudView::ReloadRingInner(float H)
{
	return ReloadRingInnerH * H;
}

float SupercutHudView::ReloadRingOuter(float H)
{
	return ReloadRingOuterH * H;
}

float SupercutHudView::CylinderDegrees(float GunTurns)
{
	// Each turn is already eased by the gun's cock (0 to 1); a back-out ease of it runs past the chamber and back.
	const float Whole = FMath::FloorToFloat(GunTurns);
	const float U = GunTurns - Whole - 1.f;
	const float Turn = 1.f + (CylinderOvershoot + 1.f) * U * U * U + CylinderOvershoot * U * U;   // 0 at the start, 1 at the end
	return 360.f / FSupercutTuning::Get().RevolverRounds * (Whole + Turn);
}

FVector2D SupercutHudView::ChamberCentre(int32 Seat, int32 Chambers, float Degrees, float W, float H)
{
	const float Angle = FMath::DegreesToRadians(360.f * Seat / Chambers + Degrees);
	return CylinderCentre(W, H) + ChamberRingH * H * FVector2D(FMath::Sin(Angle), -FMath::Cos(Angle));
}

bool SupercutHudView::IsChamberLoaded(int32 Seat, int32 Chambers, int32 ShotsFired, int32 Rounds)
{
	// After n more shots the gun's hammer is on seat (Chambers - (ShotsFired + n) % Chambers) % Chambers (ASupercutCharacter's
	// round meshes), so Seat fires after this many more; it holds a round if that comes before the rounds run out.

float SupercutHudView::CylinderOutline(float AngleDegrees, float Degrees, float H)
{
	// The nearest flute's middle sits half a chamber's step past each chamber; Off is the angle from it.
	const float Face = CylinderRadius(H);
	const float Step = 360.f / FSupercutTuning::Get().RevolverRounds;
	const float FromFlute = AngleDegrees - Degrees - 0.5f * Step;
	const float Off = FMath::DegreesToRadians(FromFlute - Step * FMath::RoundToFloat(FromFlute / Step));
	// The flute is a circle FluteRadiusR across, its centre outside the face so its edge reaches in to FluteBottomR.
	const float Flute = FluteRadiusR * Face;
	const float Out = FluteBottomR * Face + Flute;
	const float Miss = Flute * Flute - FMath::Square(Out * FMath::Sin(Off));
	return Miss > 0.f ? FMath::Min(Face, Out * FMath::Cos(Off) - FMath::Sqrt(Miss)) : Face;
}

float SupercutHudView::ChamberRadius(float H)
{
	return ChamberR * CylinderRadius(H);
}

float SupercutHudView::ReloadRingInner(float H)
{
	return ReloadRingInnerR * CylinderRadius(H);
}

float SupercutHudView::ReloadRingOuter(float H)
{
	return ReloadRingOuterR * CylinderRadius(H);
}

The follow-up is one commit on top of `942a8ad`: `33bf6a8` on branch hud3, done at 20:26. No merge or push, and I did not run main's merge check.

**What changed**
1. **Opaque face:** the cylinder face is fully opaque now, so a flash behind it can't tint it. In the before/after sheet, the orange hit flash in g_refilled shows through the old face and not through the new one.
2. **Pointer:** 1.5 times larger, now 0.1275 of the face radius tall and 0.225 wide. A bigger pointer would have run into the reload ring, so the ring moved out by the same amount (0.0425 of the face radius) to keep its gap. That makes the cylinder's box a little bigger, so the face sits about 6 px further up and left at 1080, a bit closer to the hand. It's on the overlap list. `HudCylinderScale` stays at 3.0.
3. **Script on main's timing:** `Script/hud3_ammo.txt` now fires every 0.45 s from 1.00 to 3.25. The reload starts by itself at 3.56 and the pictures fall at:
   - a6 at 3.45
   - r_before_seat at 4.60
   - the seat at 5.04
   - r_after_seat at 5.40
   - g_refilled at 6.10
